key.name: snap-layouts
key.description: Five layouts; 1-5 tiles the focused window and the others on this desktop.

key.name: coder-desktop
key.description: An editor, a terminal and a browser on localhost onto a fresh desktop, side by side.

key.name: dock
key.description: The glass dock. It only shows while Dash to Dock is off.

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.description: The icons' size at rest; they grow under the pointer (dock-hover-scale).

key.name: dock-hover-scale
key.description: How much the icon under the pointer grows; its neighbours grow a little under half as much.

key.name: blur
key.description: Blur behind the top bar islands, the dock and the switcher. Paused while a window is full screen; off while Blur my Shell is on.

key.name: fresh-snip
key.description: The screenshot tool opens with no box (not last time's): drag any area.

key.name: snip-auto-capture
key.description: Letting go of a new area takes the screenshot at once (saved and copied).

key.name: top-bar-style
key.description: islands: three floating glass capsules. edge: one seamless glass bar.

key.name: show-active-app
key.summary: Active app in the top bar
key.description: The focused app's icon (in its own colours) and name, with a menu for its window.

key.name: autohide-top-bar
key.description: While a window has focus the top bar glides away; the top edge, an empty desktop or the overview bring it back. Windows get its space while this is on.
